name: -6AN 45° Degree Bulkhead Fitting
title: -6AN 45° Degree Bulkhead Fitting
description:
The -6AN 45° Degree Bulkhead Fitting is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings -6AN 45° Degree Bulkhead Fittings are precision CNC-machined adapters designed to route AN lines at a 45-degree angle through firewalls, panels, fuel cells, and chassis components. Engineered for high-performance fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems, these AN bulkhead fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal on both sides of the panel.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
• Flow Configuration: 45° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
